payload.name: Extract All Explicitly Stated Memory Details
payload.description: When a user reflectively recounts a past experience and explicitly mentions multiple distinct details (activities, places, topics shared, outcomes), during extraction.
content: During extraction, when a message explicitly lists several distinct details about one past experience (for example, activities, routes, topics discussed, or emotional outcomes), include every explicitly stated detail in the candidate; do not summarize only the main gist.
If the details form a bounded list in one statement, one candidate is enough; do not create separate candidates for each detail or add unmentioned details.
During CRUD, if a later message supplies an omitted explicit detail for an existing memory, UPDATE or MERGE that memory to add the detail instead of creating a duplicate.

solves: When a user recounts a past experience and explicitly lists multiple concrete details (activities, routes, topics shared, outcomes), extraction may keep only the main gist and drop one of the explicitly stated details, leaving the stored memory incomplete.
